revealed_content.statement: The current returns policy explicitly states that standard items can be returned within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, matching the claimed 30-day window.
revealed_content.plan: Extracted the numeric return windows from the bundled artifacts, compared the claimed 30 days to the current policy value, and checked the stale base retrieval/judge reference; a two-sample t-test was not applicable because the data contain no n, mean, or sd fields.
